limitations: Eight combinations have actual runtime evidence; these short per-phase samples do not replace long-term, display-scanout, visual-quality or performance acceptance.
VVL core and synchronization enabled. Final strict zero-error gate fails with 224 recorded errors and 30 unreviewed warnings; existing emulator issues are retained, not repaired.
Two SDK DLFG clone image initial-layout errors occurred at first FG enable. They must not be silently grouped with known emulator errors or ignored by message ID alone.
No safe NR failure injection, ten FG-active NR toggles, minimized recovery or resize with active FG this round.
Continuous SR/FG toggle coverage uses matching revision, same SR fence and advancing FG timeline; control updates preserve unchanged consumers.
Depth is synthetic, NVOF estimates unprocessed-frame motion, and source is selected emulator color rather than native TAA input.
